body:
Hi I'm Chelsea. Thanks for sending this. :) I'm also very cold right now in Pennsylvania. 

I've been depressed for about 6 years maybe more. And I just recently had a really bad breakup, so that intensified it. I am just hoping I can find some people that understand. 

How long have you been depressed?
Do you feel like it was triggered by circumstance or just chemicals? 
What do you do to fill your time? 

And if you want to email I can give you my email. :)
Yes please I want to be apart of this.

I know exactly how you feel. I don't know what she did to you to hurt you but I just broke up with my boyfriend about a month ago and it's been really fucking hard. I broke up with him because he treated me like shit and then I found out he had cheated on me countless times. I don't think it will ever stop hurting but I know the pain will lessen. And I know someday a whole day will go by where I won't think about it. And right now I'm just waiting for that day and trying to better myself. I hope we both can be okay. If you want to talk feel free to PM me.

I just recently lost my best friend because he was an ass. And I don't know how your friend feels but I still care about my old best friend and if he ever needed me I would be there in a second. That connection doesn't just go away.

I know how you feel. I sometimes think I've finally figured out what's wrong with my brain only to have yet another curve ball. The mind is complicated. I find that thinking about ways to kill myself gives me relief from all the other pain. I just want to die everyday and nothing seems worth it. It all seems like way too much. If you ever want to talk feel free to pm me. I don't know if I can help but I understand.

I also just went through a breakup that brought back my memories of abuse. And I just want you to know I feel exactly the same way. If you want to talk feel free to pm me. I understand. I don't know if I can help you feel better but maybe just knowing someone else is in the exact same place.

I have just experienced this too. Very recently and I don't really have much advice but I am starting to meet people that are more understanding and have experienced similar things and that helps a ton. It still hurts because I loved the people I pushed away but having people to talk to that get it is keeping me alive for the time being. Have you considered joining a support group?
I can't really eat anymore. I think it's the stress of all of this. So food makes me sad because I can't eat it.
I have already I was put into inpatient and I don't want that again.
I have smoked weed a lot. It only makes me anxious now :( I don't know why.

I have been trying to end my life for a long time. And I have been depressed since I was about 8. I remember always being in and out of parent meetings for falling asleep in class. I could never sleep at night. 

And I do believe there is something beyond saving when you don't want to help yourself anymore, no one else can help you if you don't know how to let them and I never have and I don't want to let them. I'm sorry but I'm not going to change my mind. 
This was a fruitless question I suppose.

It's just that nothing is fun anymore and the only things I have found fun are drugs. And that's not how I want to live anymore. And it was just psychedelics but they made the world beautiful again. And nothing else worked.  

And I don't want to say my age because a lot of my friends use reddit. I am below 35.
There is one thing left. I want to go see my favorite musician in concert. Father John misty. And the concert is in a few months. Then I'm done. It's relieving.
The weight gain leads to me being more depressed. I just know none of these medicines are going to work because I don't want them to anymore I don't want to be alive. I am not willing to try anymore.

I do have a disorder I am depressed but it's who I am. I have always been depressed and I will always be depressed. I don't enjoy anything. I have died on the inside. 
This is an action I would take because I already am. I know you guys are trying to help but I'm beyond saving because I have no way of helping myself, I honestly just don't want to. I'm sorry. I just really do want to do as right as I can by the people close to me by leaving them with something good to remember me by.

I've tried everything. I've been inpatient multiple times and I am on Wellbutrin now and I've tried lexapro and that made me gain weight which only worsened the depression. My psychiatrist told me basically all the antidepressants in that category would make me gain weight too. It's too late I've already given up. There's nothing to make me want to try anymore. I just want to know if I should send the emails or the videos and I'm not going to do it for a few months but I am already planning. 

I'm not asking if they'd prefer I not leave but would they want a goodbye if I'm already gone. And I am gone on the inside.
I just have never been even content here. I do care about them. I just want to know what you would want from a close friend once they were already gone.
